info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Insurances-v3-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Insurance Listing API enables developers to retrieve a comprehensive list of available insurance options for pharmacy prescriptions. This endpoint is designed to assist healthcare providers, pharmacists, and insurance representatives in understanding which insurances are accepted for specific prescriptions. By leveraging this API, stakeholders can enhance patient care by facilitating informed decisions regarding medication coverage. The API supports essential operations for fetching updated insurance data, ensuring accessibility for applications managing prescription services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch insurance details associated with a specific prescription. It provides necessary data such as the insurance provider, coverage details, and any applicable copays or deductibles, helping users understand their out-of-pocket costs.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving insurance information related to prescriptions. This request may include parameters or filters to specify the desired insurance details.
